label: Earth Warden
note: Scenes written for an all-women cast. Card order is the site's: 22 Majors, then Wands, Cups, Swords, Pentacles, each Ace to Ten, Page, Knight, Queen, King. No artist is named anywhere in these prompts, and none may be added.
style: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: finished full-bleed portrait illustration for one card of the Earth Warden tarot deck. Style: luminous mythic fantasy painting, richly detailed and painterly, collectible quality. Ancient wild places lit from within: glowing moss and fungi, drifting fireflies and motes of light, shafts of light through old trees, soft aurora over stone. Palette: moss and fern green, deep loam brown, lichen grey, warm amber and antique gold, with pale luminous green-gold and moon-white accents; dark, rich and glowing overall. Every human figure is a woman: wardens of the land, of varied ages, builds and skin tones, dignified and capable, fully clothed in practical layered garments of wool, linen, leather and woven grasses with gold and stone ornaments. Faces are natural and expressive; hands are well formed with five fingers. Composition: one clear scene, the main figure or object large and central, readable at small size, the whole subject inside the frame with a little quiet space at every edge. When the scene gives an exact number of objects, show exactly that many, each one separate and easy to count. This is the complete artwork seen straight on, not a photograph of a card and not a mockup. No text, no letters, no numbers, no Roman numerals, no runes or writing of any kind, no labels, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame, no card outline.

suit_objects.wands: In this deck a wand is a tall living wooden staff with a few fresh green leaves budding from it and a soft glow at its tip.
suit_objects.cups: In this deck a cup is a chalice carved from pale river stone and shell, glowing faintly with clear water.
suit_objects.swords: In this deck a sword is a long straight blade of polished black obsidian with a bronze hilt.
suit_objects.pentacles: In this deck a pentacle is a round disc of gold and carved stone, about the size of a plate, bearing a five-petalled flower carved in its face.

back_style: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: the ornamental card back for the Earth Warden tarot deck, a full-bleed portrait design seen straight on. Luminous mythic fantasy ornament, richly detailed, collectible quality. No text, no letters, no numbers, no runes or writing, no watermark, no signature, no human figures.
back: A perfectly symmetrical, reversible design that reads the same upside down: at the centre a great tree whose spreading roots exactly mirror its spreading branches, enclosed in a ring of woven vines, ferns, antlers and small round seed-discs, with repeating fern and leaf ornament filling the whole field edge to edge. Fine luminous moss-green and antique-gold line work on a deep forest-black ground, scattered with tiny firefly lights. Mirror symmetry both left to right and top to bottom.
scenes: A young warden with a small pack and a red fox at her heel steps lightly onto a mossy root-bridge over a misted gorge at first light, her face lifted and unafraid, fireflies rising around her. Trust and beginnings.

A warden stands behind a flat stone altar in a forest clearing, one hand raised high holding a glowing living branch and the other hand pointing down to the earth. On the altar lie exactly four objects, well separated: one wooden staff, one stone chalice, one black obsidian sword and one round gold disc. A loop of light shaped like a sideways figure-eight floats above her head. Skill and focused will.

A still, veiled warden sits between a pale birch trunk and a dark yew trunk at the mouth of a spring cave, a closed bark-bound book resting in her lap, a thin crescent moon reflected in the dark pool at her feet. Intuition and hidden knowledge.

A full-figured, visibly pregnant warden in green and gold reclines on a throne of living roots among ripe wheat, poppies and fruiting trees beside a bright stream, a crown of small white starflowers in her hair. Abundance and nurture.

A silver-haired matriarch in a mantle of lichen grey and rust sits upright and commanding on a throne carved from a single boulder with ram-horn armrests, a stone orb in one hand and an oak sceptre in the other, bare mountains behind her. Structure, protection and authority.

An elder teacher-warden seated between two tall standing stones raises one hand in blessing over two younger women who kneel attentively before her. Two large crossed keys made of antler lie on the stone step between them. Shared tradition and generous teaching.

Two women stand facing each other across a narrow stream, their outstretched hands touching over the water, one beside a fruiting apple tree and the other beside a flowering hawthorn. Above them a great winged spirit of light, a woman with open arms, blesses the meeting. Choice and union.

A warden stands tall in a small chariot of woven willow and bronze on a forest road. Two great elk, one pale and one dark, stand harnessed in front of it, both facing forward. A canopy of stars above her. Opposing forces held in balance by will.

A calm woman rests both hands gently on the muzzle of a huge seated brown bear that leans peacefully toward her. A loop of light shaped like a sideways figure-eight floats above her head; wildflowers at her feet. Gentle courage, no struggle.

An old warden in a heavy hooded cloak stands alone on a high rocky path at night, holding up a lantern that contains a single star of light and leaning on a tall staff, vast quiet distance below her. Solitude and guidance.

A great eight-spoked wheel of woven roots and stone stands upright and turning in a forest clearing. A hare climbs one side of the wheel, a serpent descends the other side, and an owl sits calmly on top. No human figures. Cycles and turning fortune.

A seated warden between two plain straight stone pillars holds a balanced bronze scale in one hand and one upright black obsidian sword in the other, looking directly at us. Strictly symmetrical and calm. Truth and fair consequence.

A serene woman hangs upside down by one ankle from the living branch of a T-shaped tree, her free leg bent behind the straight leg, her hands resting behind her back, a soft halo of fireflies around her head. Peaceful, no injury. Surrender and a new view.

A tall cloaked woman wearing a smooth bone-white mask rides a pale horse at a walk across a field of cut grain at dusk. One fresh green shoot rises in the foreground. Her dark banner bears a single white rose, and the sun rises between two distant standing stones. Endings that make room for renewal; calm, no violence.

A winged warden pours a thin bright stream of water between exactly two stone chalices, one in each hand, standing with one foot on the mossy bank and one foot in the shallow stream. Irises grow beside her and a path winds to a small sun on the horizon. Patient blending and balance.

A horned, bat-winged woman-spirit of the dark wood sits on a low black stone in dim ember light. Below her two clothed women stand with loose chains of vine around their waists, chains so slack they could lift them off. Attachment that could be set down.

A tall narrow stone watchtower on a crag is struck by one jagged bolt of lightning. Its crown of stone breaks away in sparks, and two small cloaked women fall through the open air beside it. Storm sky. Sudden rupture and revelation, without gore.

A clothed woman kneels at the edge of a pool at night with one knee on the bank, pouring water from exactly two jugs, one into the pool and one onto the ground. Above her shines one very large eight-pointed star surrounded by smaller stars, and a small bird sits in a tree behind her. Hope and renewal.

A large full moon with a calm woman's profile in it hangs above a path that winds into the distance between two tall standing stones. A wolf and a dog sit on either side of the path howling up at the moon, and a crayfish climbs out of a dark pool in the foreground. No human figures. Dreams, instinct and uncertainty.

A laughing young girl in a simple tunic rides a white horse bareback with her arms flung wide beneath a huge radiant sun. Tall sunflowers grow along a low stone wall behind her and a long red ribbon streams from her hand. Joy and vitality.

A great winged warden-spirit in the clouds sounds a long spiral horn of shell. Below her exactly three women in grey garments rise from openings in the mossy earth with their arms lifted toward her, mountains in the distance. Awakening and answering a call.

A dancing woman wrapped in a long flowing scarf moves in the centre of a large oval wreath of leaves and flowers, holding a short wand of light in each hand. In the four corners of the image, half hidden in cloud, are a bull's head, a lynx's head, an eagle's head and a woman's face. Completion and wholeness.

One tall living staff, budding with fresh leaves and glowing at its tip, is held upright by a single strong woman's hand that emerges from a bank of luminous mist. Forested hills and a river lie far below. Exactly one staff. A spark of new energy.

A warden stands on a stone rampart between exactly two upright living staves fixed to the wall, holding a small round seed-globe in one hand and looking out over forest and sea. Planning and the first choice.

A warden seen from behind stands on a high cliff among exactly three upright staves planted in the ground, one hand resting on the nearest, watching small boats cross a glowing estuary far below. Foresight and expansion.

Exactly four tall staves planted upright in a meadow hold up a garland canopy of flowers and fruit. Beyond them two women in festive dress dance with raised bouquets before a homestead. Celebration and homecoming.
Exactly five young women spar in a lively tangle, each holding one long staff, the five staves crossing at different angles. Energetic and unhurt, more contest than battle. Friction and rivalry.

A woman wearing a laurel wreath rides a white horse through a crowd of cheering women, carrying one staff crowned with a second laurel wreath. Exactly five more staves are held upright by women in the crowd, making six staves in all. Recognition and public victory.
A warden on a high mossy ledge braces herself with one staff held across her body, defending her ground against exactly six staves that rise from below the ledge toward her. Standing firm.
Exactly eight leafy staves fly in parallel diagonally through the open air above a wide river valley, like arrows in flight. No people. Swift movement and news.
A weary but watchful warden with a bandage around her brow leans on one staff, standing in front of a fence of exactly eight upright staves. Resilience and guarded persistence.
A woman bent forward under the weight carries a heavy bundle of exactly ten staves in her arms along a road toward a distant village. Burden and overcommitment.
A young woman in a traveller's tunic stands on an open heath holding one tall budding staff in both hands, gazing up at its glowing leafy tip with delight. Curiosity and a bold message.
A woman in leaf-patterned armour rides a rearing chestnut horse across a bracken hillside, one budding staff held like a lance. Passion, daring and impulsive motion.

A warm, confident queen sits on a throne carved with sunflowers and lynxes, one living staff in her right hand and a sunflower in her left, a black cat sitting at her feet. Magnetism and generous confidence.
A commanding sovereign woman in a russet mantle sits forward on a throne carved with salamanders, holding one flowering staff, a small lizard on the stone beside her foot. Vision and bold leadership.

One carved stone chalice overflowing with exactly five thin streams of luminous water rests on the open palm of a woman's hand that rises from mist above a lily pond. A white dove descends toward the cup. Exactly one cup. New feeling and open-heartedness.
Two women stand facing each other, each holding one stone chalice, exchanging them in a pledge, a soft knot of light glowing in the air between them. Exactly two cups. Partnership and mutual regard.
Exactly three women dance in a circle in a harvest garden among gourds and grapes, each raising one stone chalice high, exactly three cups in all. Friendship and celebration.

A woman sits cross-armed beneath a tree, looking discontentedly at exactly three stone chalices standing in a row on the grass before her, while a hand reaching out of a small glowing mist offers her a fourth cup. Four cups in all. Apathy and an offer unnoticed.

A woman in a long dark cloak stands with bowed head before exactly three toppled stone chalices spilling water on the ground. Behind her exactly two chalices still stand upright. A bridge crosses a river to a distant house. Grief, and what still remains.

In an old walled village garden an older girl hands a stone chalice filled with white flowers to a smaller girl. Exactly five more flower-filled chalices stand around them, six cups in all. Memory, innocence and kindness.

A woman seen from behind gazes up at exactly seven stone chalices floating in luminous cloud, each holding a different small vision: a tiny castle, a heap of jewels, a laurel wreath, a serpent, a small dragon, a glowing veiled figure and a woman's face. Choices, fantasy and illusion.

A cloaked woman with a walking staff walks away up a rocky river path beneath an eclipsed moon, leaving behind in the foreground exactly eight stone chalices stacked in two rows, five below and three above. Walking away to seek something deeper.

A contented, well-fed woman sits with folded arms on a wooden bench in front of a curved shelf draped in blue cloth, on which exactly nine stone chalices stand in a single row. Satisfaction and wishes granted.

Two women stand arm in arm with their free arms raised toward a rainbow in which exactly ten stone chalices are set in an arc. Two little girls dance beside them; a cottage and a stream lie beyond. Lasting happiness and belonging.

A young woman in a blue tunic stands on the shore holding one stone chalice, from which a small fish pops its head; she smiles at it in surprise. Exactly one cup. Tender curiosity and a gentle message.
A graceful woman in light armour and a winged helmet rides a calm white horse at a walk toward a river, holding one stone chalice out before her. Exactly one cup. Romance, invitation and idealism.

A queen sits on a shell-carved throne at the very edge of the sea, gazing intently at one ornate lidded chalice that she holds in both hands, smooth pebbles at her feet. Exactly one cup. Compassion and deep intuition.

A calm sovereign woman sits on a stone throne that floats steady on a turbulent sea, one stone chalice in one hand and a short sceptre in the other. A fish leaps from a wave and a ship sails behind her. Exactly one cup. Emotional mastery.

One upright black obsidian sword is held by a woman's hand that rises from cloud. Its point passes through a small crown of gold from which hang an olive branch and a fern frond. Jagged peaks below. Exactly one sword. Clarity and breakthrough.

A blindfolded woman in pale robes sits on a stone bench beside a night sea with her arms crossed over her chest, holding exactly two obsidian swords that point up and outward. A crescent moon above, rocks in the water. Stalemate and a guarded heart.
A large heart-shaped stone of deep red garnet floats in a grey storm sky with rain falling, pierced through by exactly three obsidian swords. No people. Heartbreak and painful truth.

A woman in armour lies at rest with her hands together on a stone bier in a quiet chapel of rock lit by coloured light. Exactly three obsidian swords hang point-down on the wall above her, and exactly one sword lies along the side of the bier, four in all. Rest and recovery.

A smirking woman in the foreground holds exactly two obsidian swords over her shoulder and a third in her other hand pointing at the ground, while exactly two more swords lie on the ground at her feet, five in all. Two dejected women walk away toward a choppy sea beneath ragged clouds. Hollow victory.

A ferrywoman poles a flat boat across calm water toward a far wooded shore. In the boat sit a cloaked woman and a young girl with their backs to us, and exactly six obsidian swords stand upright in the bow. Passage toward calmer water.

A woman tiptoes away from a camp of tents carrying exactly five obsidian swords in her arms, glancing back with a sly smile at exactly two swords left standing upright in the ground behind her, seven in all. Stealth and strategy.

A blindfolded woman with loose bindings around her arms stands on wet marshy ground surrounded by exactly eight obsidian swords planted upright around her, a crag with a keep in the distance. Feeling trapped by one's own thoughts.

A woman sits up in bed in the dark with her face in her hands. On the black wall behind her exactly nine obsidian swords hang horizontally, one above another. Her quilt is embroidered with roses. Anxiety and sleepless worry.

A long dark cloak lies on a shore beneath a black sky, shaped as though someone lies beneath it, with exactly ten obsidian swords planted upright in a row along its length. No blood and no visible body. On the horizon the water is calm and a band of golden dawn is breaking. A painful ending, and the first light after it.

A young woman stands on windy high ground holding one obsidian sword upright in both hands, looking alertly over her shoulder. Wind-tossed trees, racing clouds and a flight of birds. Vigilance and a quick mind.
A woman in armour charges at full gallop on a white horse into the wind, one obsidian sword raised high, her cloak streaming behind her under storm clouds. Ambition and headlong action.

A stern, clear-eyed queen sits in profile on a high stone throne carved with butterflies, holding one obsidian sword perfectly upright in her right hand and lifting her open left hand, clouds gathered below her. Perception and honest boundaries.

A sovereign woman with a level gaze sits facing us on a tall throne carved with butterflies and crescent moons, holding one obsidian sword upright and slightly tilted. Cypress trees and high clouds behind her. Intellect and fair authority.

One large round disc of gold and carved stone rests in the open palm of a woman's hand that emerges from glowing mist above a garden. A hedge archway of roses and lilies leads toward distant mountains. Exactly one disc. A real opportunity taking root.

A young woman in a tall cap dances lightly while juggling exactly two round discs joined by a ribbon of light looped in a sideways figure-eight. Behind her two ships ride high rolling waves. Balancing and adapting.

A stonemason woman stands on a bench carving an archway in a woodland chapel while two other women, one holding an unrolled blank plan and one elder in a hood, consult with her. Exactly three round discs are carved into the arch above them. Craft and collaboration.

A woman sits on a stone block clasping one round disc tightly to her chest, with one disc balanced on her head and one disc under each foot, exactly four in all. A town lies behind her. Holding on and security.
Two women, one on a crutch and one wrapped in a thin shawl, walk through falling snow past a lit window of coloured glass in which exactly five round discs glow. Hardship, and help that is close by.

A prosperous woman in a red mantle holds a small balance scale in one hand and with the other drops coins into the cupped hands of one of two kneeling women. Exactly six round discs float in the air above them. Generosity and fair exchange.

A farmer woman leans on her hoe and looks thoughtfully at a leafy bush on which round discs grow like fruit: exactly six on the bush and exactly one on the ground at her feet, seven in all. Patience and assessing the harvest.

A craftswoman sits at a workbench carving a round disc with hammer and chisel. Exactly six finished discs hang on a post beside her, one is on the bench being worked and one lies at her feet, eight in all. Diligence and mastery.

An elegant woman in a flowing robe patterned with flowers stands in a vineyard heavy with grapes, a hooded falcon on her gloved hand. Exactly nine round discs rest among the vines, six on one side of her and three on the other; a snail at her feet. Self-sufficiency and earned ease.

An elderly matriarch in a richly patterned robe sits in the foreground beneath a stone archway stroking two white dogs, while two younger women and a little girl stand talking under the arch. Exactly ten round discs float across the scene. Legacy and family wealth.

A young woman stands in a green flowering meadow holding up one round disc in both hands and gazing at it in absorbed study, a ploughed field and a grove behind her. Exactly one disc. Study and a practical beginning.

A woman in dark heavy armour sits on a motionless black draught horse at the edge of a ploughed field, holding one round disc before her and studying it, oak leaves on her helmet. Exactly one disc. Steadiness and dependable work.

A queen sits on a throne carved with fruit, goats and blossoms within a bower of roses, cradling one round disc in her lap and looking down at it tenderly; a rabbit sits in the foreground. Exactly one disc. Practical care and abundance.

A sovereign woman in a robe embroidered with grapes and vines sits on a throne carved with bulls' heads, a sceptre in one hand and one round disc resting on her knee beneath the other hand. Castle walls and gardens behind her. Exactly one disc. Stewardship and material mastery.
